4␟Akhbar al-Sin wa-l-Hind: A ninth-century Arabic travel compilation, its title meaning "Account of China and India." It gathered sailors' reports of Asian lands, including tales of the fabulously wealthy king of Zabag.
6␟Sangrama Vijayottungavarman: The king of Srivijaya around 1025 CE, captured when the south Indian Chola fleet launched its surprise naval raid on his maritime empire.
